title: Large-group methods, models, and participation formats
classification_note: The complexity and purpose labels reproduce Benjamin Taylor’s teaching overview on PDF page 46. They are a way into comparison, not universal classifications. Individual slides sometimes use different positions. Families, methods, supporting models, and examples are explicitly distinguished.
source_note: The former 15 cards were document collections, including an overview folder. This index includes every named entry in the overview, the additional named examples on page 50, selected supporting models discussed in the deck, and the individual Liberating Structures guides. It is not a claim to enumerate every method in existence. Similar labels are retained where the teaching source lists them separately.

methods.title: Future Search
methods.summary: A cross-section of stakeholders works on a shared future and the action needed to pursue it.

methods.title: Three Horizons
methods.summary: Explore the current pattern, emerging alternatives, and the transition between them.

methods.title: Scenario Planning
methods.summary: Explore several plausible futures and test what they would mean for present choices.

methods.title: TIP - The Integral Process
methods.summary: Work with multiple perspectives and developmental complexity in group inquiry.

methods.title: Preferred Futuring
methods.summary: Develop a narrative of a preferred future to guide collective planning.

methods.title: Delphi Method
methods.summary: Use successive rounds of structured enquiry to explore forecasts and areas of agreement.

methods.title: Stakeholder mapping
methods.summary: Make stakeholder relationships and perspectives visible for discussion.

methods.title: Participatory Narrative Inquiry

methods.title: Soft Systems Methodology

methods.title: 1-2-4-All
methods.summary: Begin with individual reflection, develop ideas in pairs and fours, then share selected insights with the whole group.
methods.credit: Liberating Structures: Henri Lipmanowicz and Keith McCandless; most supplied one-page guides designed by Jenny Yung for Scrum Facilitators. Individual source terms apply.

methods.title: 15% Solutions
